## AC2 verification evidence (audit-text write on live + drifted DB copies)

Executed 2026-11-06T16:28Z with the installed `wl` build. Working copies only — the production `.worklog/worklog.db` was not mutated (the item's risk note flags racing live writers; copies are byte-identical via sqlite3's backup API).

### Sandbox construction
- `/tmp/ah-verify/live/.worklog/worklog.db` — backup copy of the live AI_Hell DB (schemaVersion=9, `audit_results.fingerprint` present).
- `/tmp/ah-verify/drifted/.worklog/worklog.db` — same copy, then deliberately drifted: `ALTER TABLE audit_results DROP COLUMN fingerprint`, `DELETE FROM metadata WHERE key='audit_fingerprint_added'`, `schemaVersion=8`.
  - Confirmed pre-state: `schemaVersion=('8',)`, audit_results columns = work_item_id, ready_to_close, audited_at, summary, raw_output, author (no fingerprint).

### Results
| Exercise | DB | rc | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| `wl update <disposable-item> --audit-text "Ready to close: Yes …"` | live copy (schema 9) | 0 | `success: true`, auditResult persisted, fingerprint `295360b4…` |
| `wl update <disposable-item> --audit-text …` | drifted copy (schema 8, no fingerprint column) | 0 | `success: true`, auditResult persisted, fingerprint `fbb9af39…` |
| `wl audit-set <id> --ready-to-close yes --summary … --raw-output …` then `wl update --audit-text …` (persist_audit.py sequence) | drifted copy | 0 then 0 | `success: true`; `raw_output` from audit-set preserved, summary/fingerprint from audit-text |

Drifted-copy stderr (expected, both commands): `Worklog: database at …/worklog.db has schemaVersion=8 but the application expects schemaVersion=9. Required columns were repaired automatically. see 'wl doctor upgrade' …` — i.e. the connect-time repair runs and the write succeeds.

Post-state of the drifted copy: `audit_results.fingerprint` restored, `audit_fingerprint_added='1'`, `schemaVersion` still `8` (the repair heals the column only; `wl doctor upgrade --confirm` is still what advances the version).

Disposable items were created inside the copies (`AH-0MW56QG8X0049RN2` live copy, `AH-0MW56QNIA004GMV0` drifted copy); nothing was created in the live store.

### Drift-resilience witness (AC1 red/green)
In the ContextHub worktree for mirror item WL-0MW56RBFD003J5WB, the connect-time repair was temporarily disabled (`for (const req of [] as RequiredColumn[])`, rebuilt `packages/shared`), and the new guard `tests/cli/update-audit-text-schema-drift.test.ts` was run through the test skill (`run_tests.py --scope changed --no-cache`): **both tests failed** (`Command failed: … update … --audit-text` / `… audit-set …`, suite exit 1). With the repair restored and `packages/shared` rebuilt, the same command is **green** (2/2 passed). Logs: /tmp/ah-verify/witness-repair-disabled.json (red), /tmp/green.json (green).
